references.text: Gideon blew the shofar to gather Israel for battle, just as Ehud did here in the hill country of Ephraim.
Gideon and his men used shofars as signals in battle against the enemy, in the same way that Ehud used the shofar to call the Israelites to war.
Saul blew the shofar throughout the land to gather Israel for battle, just as Ehud did in the hill country of Ephraim.
The shofar was to be used to call the people together for war, as was done here.
The continuation of this account where Ehud leads the Israelites down to seize the fords of the Jordan.
Deborah also led the Israelites in battle with herself at the front, just as Ehud went before his people.
The hill country of Ephraim is mentioned as an important geographical area for the tribe of Israel.
